- **PD-4821**, from #central-team, 9 Jun 2026. Hollis mentioned it, but in the context of Marrow Agrisupply. I left it out and asked Pree to confirm whether that is the same account.

Two gaps:
- Moss's notes: the share has no files under members/moss that I can read. The brain has Moss notes, but they're addressed to Ruth Calloway, so I didn't use them. One of them lists tickets #4409 and #4412 on "Pree's dealer account" before a Marrow Fieldworks handoff. I didn't include them because the note doesn't clearly tie them to Marrow Fieldworks, and Pree may not be able to see it. My reply to Pree didn't mention them, so she may want to ask Moss directly.
- I excluded #8841 (Plains depots, Tobias) and #88412 (Tansleigh Packaging, 2025) because they aren't Marrow accounts.
